No drives found Try adjusting your search or filters Clear all filters Show more Sabrent SSD Drives: Full Database Sabrent produces a popular lineup of NVMe SSDs under the Rocket brand. The Rocket 4 Plus-G delivers PCIe 4.0 flagship performance, while the Rocket 5 targets PCIe 5.0 with Phison E26 controller. Sabrent also offers the Rocket Nano external SSDs for portable storage. The brand is known for offering drives with and without heatsinks, giving builders flexibility in cooling. Sabrent SSDs are primarily available through Amazon and direct sales, with strong US market presence and competitive pricing.
